summary: The revised contract addresses every critical issue and every important improvement from the prior review. Each spot-checked citation matches the source verbatim: BR-8a/BR-8b enumerations align with the actual route files (verified by grep across all 14 manufacturing-orders routes and all 4 sales-orders write routes), confirmSalesOrder's beginInventoryOperationInTx replay pattern is faithfully described at sales/queries.ts:7553-7595, createManufacturingOrderInTx contains no confirmShortage branch (the only reference in manufacturing/queries.ts is the hardcoded false at line 3652 in duplicateManufacturingOrder), createSalesOrder contains no confirmOversell branch (only references are duplicateSalesOrder hardcoding true at 6050 and confirmSalesOrder's informational payload at 7567), the FOR UPDATE lock for parallel bulk-from-SO submissions is at queries.ts:3674 as claimed, and item soft-delete is gated by assertModuleWriteAccess('inventory') in both single (route.ts:18,94) and bulk (route.ts:27,40) paths. The RA-2 split (a/b/c), new BR-9 (intent-of-asymmetry as inference), new BR-10 (create-time shortage flags are dead weight), new RA-11 (SO confirm idempotency replay), new RA-12 (parallel bulk Create-MOs-from-SO row-lock serialization), and the new client_server_validation_splits section all provide the precise downstream guidance the prior review demanded. The contract now correctly distinguishes facts from inferences and explicitly marks BR-9 as low-confidence inference while BR-8a/BR-8b remain high-confidence facts. The earlier vocabulary leak in user_action #7 ('draft SO') is fixed. No new critical issues surfaced during this re-review.

important_improvements.item: Residual 'draft order edits' paraphrase in evidence[1].reason
important_improvements.what_is_wrong: Evidence line 14 in contract.json paraphrases the salesOrderLineId column comment as '...so SO line hard-delete + re-insert during draft order edits does not violate constraints.' The actual schema comment at lib/db/schema/manufacturing.ts:40-41 says 'so sales-order edits can replace line rows without being blocked by FK constraints' — no 'draft' word. This is a minor vocabulary leak that the contract elsewhere is trying to abolish. It does not change any rule or scenario, but a literal downstream phase reading the evidence reason verbatim could re-introduce 'draft order' language.
important_improvements.how_to_fix: Replace 'during draft order edits' with 'during sales-order line edits' or simply 'during sales-order edits' to match the actual code comment. Optional fix; not blocking.

prior_issue_status.evidence: BR-7 now reads 'confirmSalesOrder is NOT a pure no-op: it runs beginInventoryOperationInTx (operationName=\'confirmSalesOrder\') and finishInventoryOperationInTx so retries with the same Idempotency-Key replay the cached {id} without re-acquiring getLockedSalesOrderInTx, but it never mutates SO fields.' The api_dependencies entry for /api/sales-orders/[id]/confirm explicitly says 'Idempotency-replayed stub via beginInventoryOperationInTx: first call locks the SO row and returns {id}; subsequent calls with the same Idempotency-Key return the cached result without re-acquiring the lock.' New RA-11 covers the replay assertion surface. Spot-checked sales/queries.ts:7553-7595 — citation accurate.

prior_issue_status.issue: BR-8 idempotency scope is incomplete; conflates fact vs intent
prior_issue_status.evidence: BR-8 was split into BR-8a (idempotency-keyed endpoints, type='fact', confidence='high') and BR-8b (non-idempotent endpoints, type='fact', confidence='high'). Intent question moved to BR-9 (type='inference (intent unknown)', confidence='low'). Enumerations spot-checked against ALL 14 manufacturing-orders/*/route.ts files and ALL 4 sales-orders write routes: BR-8a lists every requireIdempotencyKey-bearing route by name (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/sales-orders[/(id|bulk)], POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/confirm, POST /api/sales-orders/bulk-confirm, POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/complete, /outputs, /pick, /batches/[batchId]/complete, /batches/[batchId]/outputs); BR-8b lists every absence-of-key route (POST/DELETE /api/manufacturing-orders, PUT/DELETE /api/manufacturing-orders/[id], POST /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]/batches/[batchId]/start, PATCH /priority, PATCH /ingredients/reorder, PUT /output-allocation, POST /duplicate, PATCH /priority-ranks, POST /api/sales-orders/[id]/manufacturing-orders). Grep across actual route files confirms every classification. GET endpoints and read-only /execution route are correctly omitted from the write-endpoint enumeration.

prior_issue_status.issue: Missing rule: confirmOversell / confirmShortage are accepted but not enforced at create
prior_issue_status.evidence: BR-10 added: 'Create-time shortage flags are dead weight. createSalesOrder unconditionally reserves the full order at insert time; confirmOversell on the body is accepted by insertSalesOrderSchema but is not consumed by createSalesOrder. createManufacturingOrderInTx similarly does not branch on confirmShortage.' Cites the precise file:line ranges. The client_server_validation_splits section also enumerates 'confirmOversell on SO create' and 'confirmShortage on MO create' splits with their non-existent rejection paths. Grep verified: confirmShortage appears in manufacturing/queries.ts only at line 3652 (duplicateManufacturingOrder hardcodes false), and confirmOversell appears in sales/queries.ts only at lines 6050 (duplicateSalesOrder hardcodes true), 7558 (function signature), and 7567 (idempotency payload) — never as a branch in createSalesOrder/createManufacturingOrderInTx bodies.

RA-2 was split into three clearly-distinguished risk areas: RA-2a (same-itemId rewrite, snapshot fallback re-link success path), RA-2b (different-itemId rewrite produces snapshot drift, SO delete blocked with canonical 'not to a matching active sales line' error), and RA-2c (rewrite while linked MO has pickAllocations: SO update succeeds, MO snapshot rebind is deferred, MO edit is then blocked by edit:work_started). Each cites the relevant file:line ranges (sales/queries.ts:6056-6241 for the no-pickAllocations-check on SO update, manufacturing/queries.ts:788-811 for productId-only fallback, manufacturing/queries.ts:3877-3882 for the MO edit guard).

structured_output.inputs.permissions now contains a fourth entry: {scope: 'Soft-delete inventory items (single and bulk)', role: 'module:inventory write', file: 'app/api/items/route.ts:27,40 and app/api/items/[id]/route.ts:18,94'}. Grep verified four assertModuleWriteAccess('inventory') call sites in those exact lines. user_action #9 now explicitly references 'Gated by module:inventory write'.

Action #7 is now titled 'Edit an open SO with line changes (same items)'. The status vocabulary in the body uses 'open SO', not 'draft SO'. No other action references 'draft'. A residual 'draft order edits' string survives in evidence[1].reason (a paraphrase of the schema comment), but this is in an evidence-reason paraphrase, not an assertion; logged as a non-blocking important_improvement.

prior_issue_status.issue: Missing RA: SO confirm idempotency replay
prior_issue_status.evidence: RA-11 added: 'SO confirm idempotency replay: Posting twice to /api/sales-orders/[id]/confirm with the same Idempotency-Key replays through beginInventoryOperationInTx (sales/queries.ts:7563-7591) and returns the cached {id} on the second call without re-running getLockedSalesOrderInTx.' Specifies the three assertions tests should make (both responses 200, exactly one inventory_operations row per key, status remains 'open'). Citation verified at sales/queries.ts:7563-7591.

prior_issue_status.issue: Missing RA: parallel bulk Create-MOs-from-SO submissions
prior_issue_status.evidence: RA-12 added: 'Parallel bulk Create-MOs-from-SO submissions — row-lock serialization. createManufacturingOrdersFromSalesOrderInTx acquires FOR UPDATE on the salesOrders row at manufacturing/queries.ts:3663-3674, so concurrent POSTs to /api/sales-orders/[id]/manufacturing-orders against the same SO serialize at that lock.' Specifies the two observable outcomes for the second caller ({created:[], skipped:[...existing_active_mo]} or 409 'Selected manufacturing orders changed. Refresh and try again.'). Citation verified at queries.ts:3674 (FOR UPDATE on salesOrders row).

prior_issue_status.issue: Action #4 missing bom_required / bom_changed failure modes
prior_issue_status.evidence: Action #4 now reads: '...Server rejects with 400 bom_required if the product BOM is empty, or 409 bom_changed if the submitted ingredient row count does not match the active BOM row count (e.g. BOM was edited after the picker rendered).' Cites manufacturing/queries.ts:821-836.

prior_issue_status.issue: BR-1 cancellation-only path needed clarifying note
prior_issue_status.evidence: BR-1 now includes: 'In practice deletedAt is set only on cancelled OPEN MOs because deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx refuses to soft-delete a finalized MO (status=\'done\' OR completedAt!=null OR actualQuantity>0 — see queries.ts:6379-6391). So the claim-reopening path is realized through cancellation of an open MO, not through deletion of a completed MO.' Evidence list now includes a fourth entry citing the finalized guard.

New structured_output.client_server_validation_splits array with 5 entries: (1) Sales-link required fields when salesOrderId is set, (2) salesOrderId/salesOrderLineId one-null-one-set, (3) productId in bulk-from-SO mode, (4) confirmOversell on SO create, (5) confirmShortage on MO create. Each documents the client schema behavior, server schema behavior, and effect.

prior_issue_status.issue: RA-3 wording around BOM count drift
prior_issue_status.evidence: RA-3 was rewritten to: 'After 948c155e, POST /api/manufacturing-orders with both ids set goes through prepareCreateIngredientsInTx, which expects the submitted ingredient row count to match the current BOM row count exactly. The form seeds ingredients from productMap at form-load time and does NOT subscribe to BOM revisions. If the BOM is edited (component added/removed) between form load and submit, the create returns 409 bom_changed and the user must reload.' Correctly identifies the regression surface as BOM-edited-between-form-load-and-submit, not 'client mixed non-BOM rows'.
